what: C5 TD-consistency auxiliary — RUNG 2 (the live-training fork A/B)

design.pool: PRE-SEEDED from the base's full 12-snapshot pool, byte-identical across arms, sha256[0:16]=f32030c514cb6020
design.single_variable: launchdiff vs the base cleared ALL differences across 233 flag tokens: only --td-aux-coef and --seed
design.defect_this_re_run_fixes: the first attempt forked gen-14 into NEW run dirs; SnapshotPool state is derived entirely from the directory (no manifest), so the arms started poolless and --self-play silently fell back to the BOT pool. Verified closed here by the startup line '[SELFPLAY] Pool has 12 snapshots'.

gate1_mechanism.bar: recorded self-KO dV dispersion ratio vs truth falls from ~4.5x toward <=2x
gate1_mechanism.method: each fork's OWN eval traces at step 28000032. self-KO := chosen in {explosion,selfdestruct} AND our side fainted in outcome.events. dV = recorded values[i+1]-values[i]; truth dG = discounted return-to-go delta from per-decision rewards, gamma=0.9999 (the single construction site in train_rl_agent).

verdict.lam=3.0: OVERSHOOT to 0.534 — the critic's delta now varies LESS than truth; the constant-predictor limit the lever doc named, reached at lambda=3 under live training

gate1_mechanism.NEW_FINDING: the suppression is GLOBAL, not self-KO-specific: all-transition dispersion tracks the self-KO figure to three decimals at lambda=0 (3.292 vs 3.233) and lambda=1 (1.461 vs 1.459). The loss is a global delta-smoother. (This does not contradict rung 1's targeting claim, which compared DELTA std against LEVEL std — a different contrast — but 'it fixes self-KO specifically' is not supported.)
gate1_mechanism.caveat: self-KO n = 115/79/77 per arm; std(dG truth) differs across arms (1.50/1.39/1.39) because different policies realise different returns, so the denominators are not perfectly matched.

gate2_behavior.bar: explosion-when-available rate and selfko dV_med move toward the reward's verdict (the standing finding is that the critic OVER-values self-KO)

verdict.lam=1.0: PASS — targeted: selfdestruct -20%, explosion -15%, little else moves
verdict.lam=3.0: NOT a corrected policy — protect doubles, pursuit 2.6x, counter halves; a broadly altered policy consistent with the EV collapse

gate3_no_harm.bar: value explained-variance and pool rollout-PIT flat-or-better; quick bot eval non-inferior

verdict.lam=3.0: FAIL — explained variance 0.748 -> 0.126, a 6x collapse, with value_pred_std 11.89 -> 2.91: the critic is predicting near-constant. The auxiliary gradient is ANTI-ALIGNED with the policy gradient (-0.146) while taking a 15% share.
verdict.lam=1.0: MARGINAL MISS — EV -0.041, mean_abs_err +0.045; PIT unmoved; bot eval non-inferior (0.9112 vs 0.9025, best of the three). 'Flat-or-better' is not strictly met.

gate3_no_harm.PRE_REGISTERED_RISK_FIRED: the lever doc's own con: 'Baird residual-gradient double-sampling bias ... under live stochastic transitions the coefficient is a bias-variance dial — gate on level calibration (explained variance, pool-PIT) not regressing.' That is exactly the failure mode, at exactly the named metric. Rung 1 tested the loss on a FROZEN representation with return-to-go targets; survival under live GAE/PopArt and a co-adapting trunk was listed as Not-known, and it did not survive at lambda=3.

bait_leverage_SEPARATE_LINE.note: NOT part of the rung-2 gates — a different question (bait leverage vs critic health), reported on its own line per owner instruction.
bait_leverage_SEPARATE_LINE.verdict: FALSIFIED, in the OPPOSITE direction. The beliefs improved monotonically with lambda while the policy became MORE committed to the whiff. TD-aux is NOT the bait lever.

OVERALL.lam=3.0: KILLED — gate 3 FAIL outright; gate 1 overshoots into under-dispersion; gate 2 shows a broadly altered policy. The lever's own rule ('any gate failing -> re-tune or kill before a generation slot') applies.
OVERALL.lam=1.0: Passes gates 1 and 2, marginally misses gate 3. It does what it was built to do (self-KO dV dispersion 3.23 -> 1.46, self-KO selection -20%, bot eval non-inferior) at a small critic cost and with NO bait benefit. By the letter of gate 3 this is a re-tune, not a pass. OWNER JUDGEMENT: the case for is that it is the only arm to hit its mechanism and behaviour targets; the case against is that it would earn a generation slot on a -0.041 EV debt for a payoff the bait hunt has already shown it does not deliver.
